business_summary: Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund is a closed-ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Federated Investors, Inc. The fund is managed by Federated Investment Management Company. It invests in fixed income markets of United States. The fund primarily invests in tax-exempt municipal bonds of GO state, GO local, special tax, hospital, transportation, pre-refunded, senior care, water and sewer, education, electric and gas, and public power sectors. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against S&P Municipal Bond Index. Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund was formed on December 20, 2002 and is domiciled in United States.
business_summary_ko: Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund는 Federated Investors, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Federated Investment Management Company가 관리합니다. 미국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 주로 GO 주, GO 지방, 특별세, 병원, 교통, 선환급, 노인 요양, 상하수도, 교육, 전기 및 가스, 공공 전력 부문의 면세 지방채에 투자합니다. S&P Municipal Bond Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund는 2002년 12월 20일에 결성되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
